contracts.capture: capture_baseline_async(duration_ms, timeout=5) requires primary visual-state v2; observes actual camera/frame, starts an empty recipe, does not pause trajectory motion, refuses pending Movie owners, and preserves the previous/latest recipe on failure/cancellation. contracts.reset: reset_async(timeout=5) pauses Movie and competing motion, preflights the full recorded state before mutation, restores objects once using the existing import owner, and confirms camera/frame on a coherent draw. Returns acknowledged state and retains recipe/scientific system. It restores the baseline before zero keys, unlike seek_async(0).
contracts.limits: Reset is restoration of the recorded state catalogue. Unrecorded viewport/export preferences retain ordinary import semantics. An absent baseline box is hidden. Object handles can be recreated; accepted commands can remain on timeout/cancellation. Object Undo retains current camera/environment, consistent with scene-history ownership.
